theme: build the sculpture in fewest moves
title: Sculpture Assembly: Fewest Growth-Macro Moves
strategies: trivial: one shared UNIT translated to every occupied voxel, combined by a balanced union tree (~2V ops) -- places every voxel independently

greedy: compress maximal contiguous runs along x per row, memoize+reuse identical run LENGTHS across rows via translate -- a single, local, non-recursive optimization that helps periodic/solid structure but barely helps a genuine multi-scale fractal

strong: canonicalize the voxel set as a B-ary tree bottom-up (a la BDD/SVDAG minimization), reusing any sub-cell whose occupancy pattern already occurred (up to translation or a single-axis reflection) anywhere else in the structure, searching a few candidate branching factors -- a shape addition-chain that turns O(V) into O(log V) when the target is recursively self-similar
invalid: reconstructs the target shifted by one unit along x (syntactically legal ops, wrong final shape) -- must score 0
